jobs.prompt: Ticket T-8019 (owner bug, atlas stage S3): the splitter put tests in a LATER ticket/stage than the code they test (T-0055 tests for T-0053/T-0054), breaking R-008 and failing every wave with 'Missing context' (the worker dispatch refuses context files that do not exist yet). Fix split ingest (tools/scope-commands.mjs ingest path around ticketsFromStageLists and orderTestsAfterBuild/addWiringDeps in tools/wiring.mjs): (1) a test ticket must be in the SAME stage as the build ticket(s) whose module files it tests (match by its tests/context naming the build ticket's files, or its scopeRefs) and must dependsOn those build tickets (same or later wave inside the stage); a test ticket placed in a later stage than the code it tests is repaired by moving it into the build ticket's stage with dependsOn added and a note 'moved T-x into stage S with the code it tests', or rejected per ticket (the T-8008 per-ticket rejection) when the build ticket cannot be found. (2) Context entries must exist in the repo at ticket start (git-tracked file list the ingest already reads) or be produced (files) by a ticket in its dependsOn chain; otherwise drop that context entry with a note 'dropped context X: it does not exist yet and no earlier ticket creates it'. (3) Never assign always-protected files to worker tickets: ALWAYS_PROTECTED in tools/init-profile.mjs ('.git/', '.swarm/', '.project-swarm.json', 'coordination/checks.json') plus the project profile's protected paths (use the existing protected-path helper the codebase uses; see protectedPathHit usage): a ticket whose files include one is rewritten so the protected file is removed from its files and a separate type 'human' owner-window ticket ('Owner commit window: edit <file> (<reason from the ticket>)') is added that the original ticket dependsOn when it needs the change, with a note. Tests in tests/scope-split-guards.test.mjs drive the ingest with temp fixtures: a later-stage test ticket is moved (or rejected when unmatched); a non-existing context entry is dropped while a dependsOn-produced one is kept; a ticket writing coordination/checks.json gets the file removed and an owner-window human ticket; and the rest of the split ingests. Keep tests/scope-ingest-*.test.mjs, tests/scope-root-files.test.mjs and tests/wiring-build-owns.test.mjs passing. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/scope-split-guards.test.mjs tests/scope-ingest-*.test.mjs tests/scope-root-files.test.mjs tests/wiring-build-owns.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`. Do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs, the tools/swarm folder, package files or .github. Tests: node:test with temp fixtures as existing tests in context do.

jobs.prompt: Ticket T-8020 (owner bug): an acceptance review that cannot be generated or started for one ticket (its files live in a different worktree, the review manifest cannot be built, or the review run fails to start for any reason) currently stalls the whole wave in tools/scope-loop.mjs (recordReview / queueResumeReviews ~225-250 and the wave review path) and tools/acceptance.mjs. Fix: catch per-ticket review-generation and review-start failures; for THAT ticket append a ticket note ('acceptance review skipped: <reason>; run it by hand with swarm scope acceptance-review after the wave') and a named non-blocking warning ('acceptance-review-skipped: T-x: <reason>') in the wave result; the ticket stays in review (never marked done without a review) and the rest of the wave proceeds and completes; never retry it in a loop within the same wave. Tests in tests/acceptance-review-skip.test.mjs with injected deps: a wave with two tickets in this checkout and one whose files are in a different worktree completes the two, records the warning and the note for the third, and the loop does not stall or spin; a review-start exception for one ticket is handled the same way. Keep tests/scope-loop.test.mjs and tests/ticket-target-worktree.test.mjs passing. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/acceptance-review-skip.test.mjs tests/scope-loop.test.mjs tests/ticket-target-worktree.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`. Do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs, the tools/swarm folder, package files or .github. Tests: node:test with temp fixtures as existing tests in context do.
